about: Recorded coat colours for modelled animals whose mesh came out another colour than they read in life (pipeline/appearance.py model_tint): the client tints the model's vertex colours by target / the model's measured body colour. One entry per species, with its reason and source; the multiplier is computed on every build.

bison_bison.reason: the summer coat is dark brown (the mesh came out a reddish tan, #7a4b29: a herd read from a ridge as a pale pink patch); the description allows dark brown or brown, and Aaron asked for the summer dark brown (2026-11-07)
bison_bison.source: Meagher, M. (1986). Bison bison. Mammalian Species 266: 1-8 (pelage dark brown); library/animals/appearance/bison_bison.json (body dark-brown, brown)
